title: The Offshore Reading Chamber

features.name: standing archive
features.desc-on-touch: The tide has sorted these papers by what it meant, not what it said. Each page carries the salt-marks of a different season.

features.name: memory pool
features.desc-on-touch: Water pooled in the lowest part, where names accumulate like sediment. You reach in and find your own reflection older than your face.

features.name: tide marks
features.desc-on-touch: Lines of shells and worn glass mark how high the sea remembers. Each line is a different history the tide brought back.

features.name: entry arch
features.desc-on-touch: The way through narrows toward a deeper reading, where what was taken by the sea is returned as question instead of answer.

inscription: here words move like water, and water learns what words meant
